stories.title: EU-uitbreiding weer bespreekbaar, maar wel eerst proefperiode voor nieuwe landen

en.title: EU expansion back on agenda, but with trial period for new countries first
en.summary: EU enlargement, long considered taboo in Brussels, is becoming discussable again due to support growing since the Ukraine war and Trump's reelection. Concerns about costs and compliance from new members persist, but geopolitical pressures are shifting the debate.

stories.title: Duizenden katten gestolen en doorverkocht in Vietnam, twaalf mannen opgepakt

en.title: Thousands of cats stolen and resold in Vietnam, twelve men arrested
en.summary: Vietnamese police arrested twelve suspects after approximately 2,700 cats were stolen in Ho Chi Minh City. The stolen cats were destined for resale and allegedly for consumption.

stories.title: Catalaanse separatistenleider mag tien jaar na referendum terug naar Spanje

en.title: Catalan separatist leader permitted to return to Spain ten years after referendum
en.summary: Spain's highest courts have lifted the arrest warrant against former Catalan regional president Carles Puigdemont, who has lived in exile since fleeing the country in 2017.

en.title: ChatGPT texts also receive invisible watermark
en.summary: OpenAI is embedding an invisible watermark called textGrain into ChatGPT-generated texts for EU users to help identify authentically human-written versus AI-generated content. The watermark operates through word choice patterns rather than visible markings.

stories.title: ‘Nooit meer Orbán!’: voor een soeverein Europa is uitbreiding nodig, maar wel onder strengere voorwaarden

en.title: 'Never again Orbán!': European sovereignty requires expansion, but under stricter conditions
en.summary: European expansion is necessary for sovereignty, though stricter conditions should apply to prevent leaders like Orbán from governing.

stories.title: Kattendievenbende in Vietnam opgerold: 'Duizenden dieren gestolen'

en.title: Cat theft gang in Vietnam dismantled: 'Thousands of animals stolen'
en.summary: Vietnamese police arrested twelve men involved in stealing thousands of cats in Ho Chi Minh City, with the ringleader allegedly reselling them for consumption.

stories.title: Catalaanse banneling Carles Puigdemont mag terug naar Spanje

en.title: Catalan exile Carles Puigdemont allowed to return to Spain
en.summary: Spain's Constitutional Court ruled that an amnesty law applies to Catalan separatists suspected of embezzlement, enabling former president Puigdemont to return home.

stories.title: ChatGPT gaat teksten voorzien van onzichtbaar AI-watermerk

en.title: ChatGPT to add invisible AI watermark to texts
en.summary: OpenAI will add an invisible watermark called 'textGrain' to ChatGPT-generated texts for European Union users to comply with regulations.

stories.title: Belg krijgt Nobelprijs Natuurkunde voor studie naar mysterieuze deeltjes in heelal

en.title: Belgian wins Nobel Prize in Physics for study of mysterious particles in the universe
en.summary: Belgian scientist Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for pioneering the measurement of neutrinos, high-energy particles produced in space.

stories.title: Belg Francis Halzen krijgt Nobelprijs voor Natuurkunde voor zijn onderzoek naar ‘spookdeeltjes’ op Antarctica

en.title: Belgian Francis Halzen wins Nobel Prize in Physics for research into 'ghost particles' in Antarctica
en.summary: Francis Halzen developed a method in 1988 to detect elusive elementary particles using clear glacier ice in Antarctica.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor Natuurkunde naar Belgische fysicus Francis Halzen, die ‘spookachtige’ deeltjes ving in het ijs van Antarctica

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physics awarded to Belgian physicist Francis Halzen, who caught 'ghostly' particles in Antarctic ice
en.summary: Belgian physicist Francis Halzen received the Nobel Prize in Physics for detecting elusive particles in Antarctic ice.

stories.title: Nobelprijs voor natuurkunde voor een enorm blok ijs dat neutrino's uit de ruimte vangt

en.title: Nobel Prize in Physics for a massive block of ice that catches neutrinos from space
en.summary: A telescope buried deep in Antarctic ice detects neutrinos, elementary particles from space that pass through most matter unimpeded.
